tabs.$description: A tab is a control (focusable, ring, disabled state, sits in the same band as buttons), so trigger.height aliases control.height.xs and tightens with the register. There is deliberately NO list.height: the list is a container of triggers and derives its height from padding + trigger. The old h-9 (36px) was arithmetically wrong — 28 + 2×4 + 2×1 = 38 — so the trigger overflowed its own list by 2px.
